video_title: Anthony Edwards' 2026 Believe That Awards ft. Druski, Bieber, Michael B. Jordan, Coco Gauff, more

quotes.speaker: Michael B. Jordan
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael B. Jordan on the challenges of directing and acting in Creed III
quotes.excerpt: I had a body double that was there. I had to basically somewhat direct him into what I was going to do

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Edwards
text_blocks.text: How was that shooting that movie? You had to be two different people.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael B. Jordan
text_blocks.text: It was crazy, man. We were down in New Orleans, it was hot. We were in three-piece suits with the hat, cars with no power steering, no AC, no roof. That heat blazing on you. But it also reminded me that's what my ancestors went through. The twin work was crazy because I had a body double that was there. I had to basically somewhat direct him into what I was going to do as the other brother so I could match my looks and where he would actually be in the scene. The complications of that stuff made it super challenging, but it was fun.

quotes.speaker: Coco Gauff
quotes.summary_phrase: Coco Gauff on her approach to confronting tennis umpires
quotes.excerpt: I'm the oldest of two younger brothers and it's just like if you're wrong, you're wrong and I'm going to stand on it

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Edwards
text_blocks.text: I love how you challenge the umpire and talk to them and let them know how you feel. Maybe he could take a few tips from you on how to handle that.

text_blocks.speaker: Coco Gauff
text_blocks.text: I'm the oldest of two younger brothers and it's just like if you're wrong, you're wrong and I'm going to stand on it. I try to do it in a respectful way though so I don't get fined. I just try to be myself at all times because people will probably ask me, 'Do you feel like you have to put on a persona?' and I'm like, 'No, because I don't want to work 24/7.' I just want to be myself and I feel like when you have a strong sense of yourself and your morals, you're not worried about what other people perceive of you because I'm still going to be me regardless.

quotes.speaker: 50 Cent
quotes.summary_phrase: 50 Cent on his long-term hustle and career mindset
quotes.excerpt: I've been hustling since 12 years old. My mom passed when I was eight and she kind of prepaid the path that I was going to go down

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Edwards
text_blocks.text: What with 50 now, tell 50 back then?

text_blocks.speaker: 50 Cent
text_blocks.text: I've been hustling since 12 years old. My mom passed when I was eight and she kind of prepaid the path that I was going to go down because the only people that I see had nice things was from her life. She was hustling and then I kind of that's where we'd have that conversation where it's like, 'Damn boy, you young, why your clothes look so old?' Sometimes we think things are we have a hard time in the beginning and it's only for the way it's going to be later. I think our passion is what separates us. He wants to win. I see it when it don't go right. When he comes into the locker room when it didn't go right, I'm like, 'Man, stop that, come on this way.'
